name: ceh-business-plan
description: CEH business plan: turn a product idea or an existing app plan into a validated business plan via a rigorous product-market-fit interview loop — draft, interrogate the weakest assumption, revise, repeat until a PMF readiness gate passes. Then harden it: a report-only board review, and specialist passes on strategy, unit economics, go-to-market, premortem, and the 90-day operating plan.
